Extracted findings from the Ghostty meta-tracking issue #8272 (primary source — official GitHub repo).

Key takeaways for the research question: Ghostty **does** implement the kitty graphics protocol but actively tracks known gaps. The issue body and its 6 open sub-issues confirm specific limitations as of June 2026: animation frames are not yet implemented (#5255, #6709), images don't scroll with text (#4323), image replacement-by-ID and stacking/z-index are buggy (#6711, #6710), and autogenerated IDs misuse the public ID range (#2197). All sub-issues remain open, so these are confirmed limitations rather than resolved items. This is directly load-bearing for the "kitty graphics protocol 지원 범위와 알려진 제약" portion of the fact-check.
